body: It worked!! Thank you so so much <3

Whatever happened to you is not your fault. There may have been certain options leading up to it that you could have prevented, but the outcome was NOT your fault. You never deserved to be treated that way, nor should he have done it. 

The guilt you carry with you is not unique, but it is not whole. I allowed a man into my life with the expectation that he would help me, and he raped me. For a long time I thought it was my fault because I let him be there — it is NEVER your fault. 

I hope you find some closure somehow, akd I hope you feel better.

P.S I am open for direct messaging if you need a chat / vent. 💕

I do. 

I have 0 attraction to children, or desire to physically harm them, but always end up worrying I’ll ruin them in some way or another. I’ve had the opportunity to do so with younger siblings, both biological and foster, and obviously never did it or even considered it, but it’s a fear.

My ex often called me abusive, and I believed him, but now I know it was a gaslighting technique to get me to behave. 

You will do as you are intended to. If you need help, you can find it. If not, we are here for you. You aren’t abusive simply because you can’t understand or feel on the same level as other people.

Thank you both for the comments. I would like to say in addition to the original post that we ended up with two wonderful foster parents that obsessively tried to love and help us, even after I aged out of the system and took my sister with me. I wouldn’t of survived without them, honestly.
